## 🔬 CAGT Internship (M2)

### aPhenoView: Genomic Imputation Pipeline for Ancient DNA

Developed at the Centre d'Anthropobiologie et de Génomique de Toulouse (CAGT), 
aPhenoView is a large-scale processing workflow dedicated to predicting phenotypic 
traits (pigmentation, cranio-facial morphology) from ancient DNA (aDNA) samples. 
Fully integrated with HPC cluster schedulers (SLURM), it ensures complete 
reproducibility of analyses across cohorts of several hundred individuals.

What sets this project apart: an **original methodological validation framework**. 
By simulating low-coverage aDNA data via GARGAMMEL, it becomes possible to train 
XGBoost models to quantify the algorithmic reliability of each phenotypic prediction 
— an approach rarely implemented in the literature.

**Tech Stack:** [Snakemake]{.badge .bg-secondary} [SLURM]{.badge .bg-secondary} [GLIMPSE2]{.badge .bg-secondary} [GARGAMMEL]{.badge .bg-secondary} [XGBoost]{.badge .bg-secondary}

## 🧪 IGF Internship (M1)

### Synaptic Plasticity & Computational Neuroscience

Carried out at the Institut de Génomique Fonctionnelle (IGF), this project involved 
building a mathematical model simulating the interactions between signalling pathways 
involved in memory and learning (PKC, CaMKII, PKA). The core of the model relies on 
a system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs), optimised via **Numba for 
simulations ~50x faster** over long biological timescales, complemented by an 
interactive GUI to explore parameters in real time.

**Tech Stack:** [Python]{.badge .bg-secondary} [SciPy]{.badge .bg-secondary} [Numba]{.badge .bg-secondary} [IPywidgets]{.badge .bg-secondary}

[📄 View Internship Report (PDF)](assets/RapportdeStage2025IGF.pdf){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm}

### SigmaView: Automated Detection of Dendritic Spines in 3D Microscopy

Also developed during the IGF internship, SigmaView is a 3D confocal imaging analysis 
tool for the automated detection of nascent dendritic spines. In the absence of existing 
tools suited to the specific biological constraints of the project (signal-to-noise ratio, 
atypical morphology of forming spines), custom segmentation algorithms were designed 
from scratch.

**Tech Stack:** [Python]{.badge .bg-secondary} [3D Image Processing]{.badge .bg-secondary}

[🐙 View Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/AlexandreGoss/TON_LIEN_GITHUB_SIGMAVIEW){.btn .btn-secondary .btn-sm}

## 💡 Personal Projects

### O.R.C.A: Cetacean Acoustic Recognition via Deep Learning

A project driven by a passion for marine bio-acoustics: training and deploying a 
convolutional neural network (CNN) for the automatic classification of cetacean 
vocalisations. Audio signals are transformed into mel-frequency spectrograms, which 
serve as input to the model for species identification. The full pipeline — from audio 
data collection to local inference — is self-contained and reproducible.

**Tech Stack:** [Python]{.badge .bg-secondary} [Keras]{.badge .bg-secondary} [CNN]{.badge .bg-secondary}

[🐙 View Source Code on GitHub](https://github.com/AlexandreGoss/TON_LIEN_GITHUB_ORCA){.btn .btn-secondary .btn-sm}

### Real-Time Trading Application

Development of a pseudo real-time visualisation application for US financial market 
data, built around a fully asynchronous architecture. This project explores continuous 
data stream management via WebSockets, synchronisation of multiple data sources, and 
the design of low-latency dynamic interfaces.

**Tech Stack:** [Python]{.badge .bg-secondary} [WebSockets]{.badge .bg-secondary} [Asyncio]{.badge .bg-secondary}
